draft.emotion: matter-of-fact and direct, identifying a part or a position
notes: 'หัว' is the everyday word for 'head' (classifier: หัว). In formal or polite contexts, use 'ศีรษะ' instead.
Also used as a classifier for round root vegetables or bulbs, such as onions (หอมหนึ่งหัว) and garlic (กระเทียมหนึ่งหัว).
